# Determine if Lukáš Melich's highest finish was as a junior
# First, extract the numeric position from the 'position' column
df['position_numeric'] = df['position'].str.extract(r'(\d+)').astype(float)

# Identify the best (minimum) numeric position
best_position = df['position_numeric'].min()

# Find the row(s) with the best position
best_rows = df[df['position_numeric'] == best_position]

# Check if any of the best finishes occurred in a junior competition
# Junior competitions are identified by 'junior' or 'u23' in the competition name
junior_keywords = ['junior', 'u23']
is_junior_best = best_rows['competition'].str.contains('|'.join(junior_keywords), case=False).any()

# Assign the result
answer = bool(is_junior_best)
answer
